name: Miki (Hyōgo, Japan, 1954–1966)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Miki city emblem in blue: an outlined triangular device of three interlocking arcs enclosing a ring.
history: Earlier flag of Miki city in Hyōgo Prefecture, used from 1954 to 1966.

features.role: Miki city emblem — an outlined triangular device of three interlocking arcs enclosing a ring
